mapper.sql: d.document_id, d.folder_id, d.owner_id, d.title, d.file_type, d.document_type, d.storage_key, d.file_size, d.content_version, d.editor_key, d.checksum, d.lifecycle_status, d.create_by, d.create_time, d.update_by, d.update_time, coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name, ''), u.user_name) as owner_name, u.avatar as owner_avatar, f.folder_name, case when d.owner_id = #{userId} then 'OWNER' else (select a.permission from doc_acl a where a.document_id = d.document_id and a.user_id = #{userId} and (a.expires_at is null or a.expires_at > now()) limit 1) end as access_permission, (select group_concat(coalesce(nullif(cu.nick_name, ''), cu.user_name) order by cu.nick_name separator '、') from doc_acl ca join sys_user cu on cu.user_id = ca.user_id where ca.document_id = d.document_id and cu.status = '0' and cu.del_flag = '0' and (ca.expires_at is null or ca.expires_at > now())) as collaborator_names, (select count(1) from doc_acl ca where ca.document_id = d.document_id and (ca.expires_at is null or ca.expires_at > now())) as collaborator_count, (select max(ol.create_time) from doc_operation_log ol where ol.document_id = d.document_id and ol.operator_id = #{userId} and ol.action_type in ('CREATE', 'OPEN')) as last_opened_time
mapper.select: select f.folder_id, f.parent_id, f.owner_id, f.folder_name, f.folder_color, f.sort_order, f.create_by, f.create_time, f.update_by, f.update_time, coalesce(s.document_count, 0) as document_count, coalesce(s.total_size, 0) as total_size from doc_folder f left join ( select folder_id, count(1) as document_count, coalesce(sum(file_size), 0) as total_size from doc_document where lifecycle_status != 'TRASH' group by folder_id ) s on s.folder_id = f.folder_id where f.owner_id = #{ownerId} and f.deleted = '0' order by f.parent_id, f.sort_order, f.folder_name

select count(1) as fileCount, coalesce(sum(file_size), 0) as totalSize, coalesce(sum(case when folder_id = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as unfiledCount from doc_document where owner_id = #{ownerId} and lifecycle_status != 'TRASH'
mapper.insert: insert ignore into doc_user_quota(user_id, quota_bytes, max_upload_bytes, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values(#{userId}, 104857600, 104857600, #{operator}, now(), #{operator}, now())
mapper.select: select user_id, quota_bytes, max_upload_bytes, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from doc_user_quota where user_id = #{userId}
select user_id, quota_bytes, max_upload_bytes, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from doc_user_quota where user_id = #{userId} for update
mapper.update: update doc_user_quota set quota_bytes = #{quotaBytes}, max_upload_bytes = #{maxUploadBytes}, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select count(1) from sys_user u where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' and exists( select 1 from sys_user_role ur join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' where ur.user_id = u.user_id and (r.role_key = 'admin' or exists( select 1 from sys_role_menu rm join sys_menu m on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id and m.status = '0' where rm.role_id = r.role_id and m.perms = 'document:file:manage' )) )
select count(1) from sys_user_role ur join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' where ur.user_id = #{userId} and r.role_key = 'admin'

select distinct u.user_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.avatar, coalesce(dept.dept_name, '') as dept_name from sys_user u left join sys_dept dept on dept.dept_id = u.dept_id where u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' and u.user_id != #{excludeUserId} and u.user_id != #{ownerId} and exists( select 1 from sys_user_role ur join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' where ur.user_id = u.user_id and (r.role_key = 'admin' or exists( select 1 from sys_role_menu rm join sys_menu m on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id and m.status = '0' where rm.role_id = r.role_id and m.perms = 'document:file:manage' )) ) and (#{keyword} = '' or instr(lower(concat_ws(' ', u.user_name, u.nick_name, coalesce(dept.dept_name, ''))), #{keyword}) > 0) order by coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name, ''), u.user_name), u.user_id limit #{limit}

select u.user_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, coalesce(dept.dept_name, '') as dept_name, count(d.document_id) as file_count, coalesce(sum(d.file_size), 0) as used_size, coalesce(q.quota_bytes, 104857600) as quota_size, coalesce(q.max_upload_bytes, 104857600) as max_upload_size, case when exists( select 1 from sys_user_role admin_ur join sys_role admin_role on admin_role.role_id = admin_ur.role_id and admin_role.status = '0' and admin_role.del_flag = '0' where admin_ur.user_id = u.user_id and admin_role.role_key = 'admin' ) then 1 else 0 end as admin_user from sys_user u left join sys_dept dept on dept.dept_id = u.dept_id left join doc_document d on d.owner_id = u.user_id left join doc_user_quota q on q.user_id = u.user_id where u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' and exists( select 1 from sys_user_role ur join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' where ur.user_id = u.user_id and (r.role_key = 'admin' or exists( select 1 from sys_role_menu rm join sys_menu m on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id and m.status = '0' where rm.role_id = r.role_id and m.perms = 'document:file:manage' )) ) group by u.user_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, dept.dept_name, q.quota_bytes, q.max_upload_bytes order by used_size desc, u.user_id
select folder_id, parent_id, owner_id, folder_name, folder_color, sort_order, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from doc_folder where folder_id = #{folderId} and deleted = '0'

select folder_id, parent_id, owner_id, folder_name, folder_color, sort_order, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from doc_folder where owner_id = #{ownerId} and parent_id = #{parentId} and deleted = '0' order by sort_order, folder_name, folder_id for update
select coalesce(max(sort_order), 0) + 10 from doc_folder where owner_id = #{ownerId} and parent_id = #{parentId} and deleted = '0'
select count(1) from doc_folder where parent_id = #{folderId} and deleted = '0'
select count(1) from doc_document where folder_id = #{folderId}
mapper.insert: insert into doc_folder(parent_id, owner_id, folder_name, folder_color, sort_order, deleted, create_by, create_time) values(#{parentId}, #{ownerId}, #{folderName}, #{folderColor}, #{sortOrder}, '0', #{createBy}, now())
mapper.update: update doc_folder set parent_id = #{parentId}, folder_name = #{folderName}, folder_color = #{folderColor}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where folder_id = #{folderId} and owner_id = #{ownerId} and deleted = '0'
update doc_folder set sort_order = #{sortOrder}, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where folder_id = #{folderId} and owner_id = #{ownerId} and parent_id = #{parentId} and deleted = '0'
update doc_folder set deleted = '1', update_time = now() where folder_id = #{folderId}
mapper.select:
select from doc_document d join sys_user u on u.user_id = d.owner_id left join doc_folder f on f.folder_id = d.folder_id and f.deleted = '0' where 1 = 1
and (d.owner_id = #{userId} or exists(select 1 from doc_acl access_acl where access_acl.document_id = d.document_id and access_acl.user_id = #{userId} and (access_acl.expires_at is null or access_acl.expires_at > now())))
and 1 = 1
and d.owner_id != #{userId} and d.lifecycle_status = 'ACTIVE'
and exists(select 1 from doc_acl permission_acl where permission_acl.document_id = d.document_id and permission_acl.user_id = #{userId} and permission_acl.permission = #{accessPermission} and (permission_acl.expires_at is null or permission_acl.expires_at > now()))
and d.lifecycle_status = 'ACTIVE' and exists(select 1 from doc_operation_log recent_log where recent_log.document_id = d.document_id and recent_log.operator_id = #{userId} and recent_log.action_type in ('CREATE', 'OPEN'))
and d.lifecycle_status = 'ARCHIVED'
and d.owner_id = #{userId} and d.lifecycle_status = 'TRASH'
and d.owner_id = #{userId} and d.lifecycle_status = 'ACTIVE'
and d.folder_id = #{folderId}
and lower(d.title) like concat('%', lower(#{keyword}), '%')
and d.file_type = #{fileType}
order by last_opened_time desc, d.update_time desc order by d.update_time desc, d.document_id desc

select d.document_id, d.folder_id, d.owner_id, d.title, d.file_type, d.document_type, d.storage_key, d.file_size, d.content_version, d.editor_key, d.checksum, d.lifecycle_status, d.create_by, d.create_time, d.update_by, d.update_time from doc_document d where d.document_id = #{documentId}

select d.document_id, d.folder_id, d.owner_id, d.title, d.file_type, d.document_type, d.storage_key, d.file_size, d.content_version, d.editor_key, d.checksum, d.lifecycle_status, d.create_by, d.create_time, d.update_by, d.update_time from doc_document d where d.document_id = #{documentId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into doc_document(folder_id, owner_id, title, file_type, document_type, storage_key, file_size, content_version, editor_key, checksum, lifecycle_status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values(#{folderId}, #{ownerId}, #{title}, #{fileType}, #{documentType}, #{storageKey}, #{fileSize}, #{contentVersion}, #{editorKey}, #{checksum}, #{lifecycleStatus}, #{createBy}, now(), #{updateBy}, now())
mapper.select: select count(1) from doc_document where owner_id = #{ownerId} and folder_id = #{folderId} and lower(title) = lower(#{title}) and lifecycle_status != 'TRASH'
mapper.update: update doc_document set folder_id = #{folderId}, title = #{title}, lifecycle_status = #{lifecycleStatus}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where document_id = #{documentId}

update doc_document set title = #{title}, file_type = #{fileType}, document_type = #{documentType}, storage_key = #{storageKey}, file_size = #{fileSize}, content_version = #{contentVersion}, editor_key = #{editorKey}, checksum = #{checksum}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where document_id = #{documentId}
mapper.select: select a.acl_id, a.document_id, a.user_id, a.permission, a.granted_by, a.expires_at, a.create_time, a.update_time, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.avatar from doc_acl a join sys_user u on u.user_id = a.user_id where a.document_id = #{documentId} and u.del_flag = '0' order by a.permission, u.nick_name, u.user_name
select acl_id, document_id, user_id, permission, granted_by, expires_at, create_time, update_time from doc_acl where document_id = #{documentId}
mapper.delete: delete from doc_acl where document_id = #{documentId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into doc_acl(document_id, user_id, permission, granted_by, expires_at, create_time, update_time) values(#{documentId}, #{userId}, #{permission}, #{grantedBy}, #{expiresAt}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select a.acl_id, a.document_id, a.user_id, a.permission, a.granted_by, a.expires_at, a.create_time, a.update_time, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.avatar from doc_acl a left join sys_user u on u.user_id = a.user_id where a.expires_at is not null and a.expires_at <= now() order by a.expires_at, a.acl_id limit #{limit}
mapper.delete: delete from doc_acl where acl_id = #{aclId} and expires_at is not null and expires_at <= now()
mapper.insert: insert into doc_version(document_id, version_no, source_type, creator_id, creator_name, create_time) values(#{documentId}, #{versionNo}, #{sourceType}, #{creatorId}, #{creatorName}, now())
mapper.select: select version_id, document_id, version_no, source_type, creator_id, creator_name, create_time from doc_version where document_id = #{documentId} order by version_no desc
mapper.insert: insert into doc_operation_log(document_id, action_type, operator_id, operator_name, target_user_id, target_user_name, previous_value, current_value, detail_content, create_time) values(#{documentId}, #{actionType}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{targetUserId}, #{targetUserName}, #{previousValue}, #{currentValue}, #{detailContent}, now())
mapper.select: select log_id, document_id, action_type, operator_id, operator_name, target_user_id, target_user_name, previous_value, current_value, detail_content, create_time from doc_operation_log where document_id = #{documentId} and action_type not in ('CREATE', 'FORCE_SAVE', 'FINAL_SAVE', 'VERSION_DOWNLOAD', 'VERSION_RESTORE', 'DOWNLOAD') order by create_time desc, log_id desc limit 200
